verdicts.reason: A: the Meridian logo hangs off the card's left edge, half on the dune image and half on white, and its red arc is missing. The card also bleeds off the top and right edges and covers almost all of the desert. Even so, the headline, body copy and a large, clear See Fares button make a proper left-to-right banner. B: the logo is intact but centred, so it doesn't line up with the left-aligned text below. The See Fares button has shrunk to an unreadable pill, which buries the CTA, and the card is jammed against the top and bottom edges with no breathing room.
